output.original_text: Haka wata rana a kasuwa nazo wucewa wurin masu tallan magani sai kawai ya fara tallan maganin fitsarin kwance,Mara mutunci yana kallona wai “sai kaga shantalelliyar budurwa San kowa Amman abun mamaki ta tsula amalala a shinfidarta 😥,bakin ciki sai naji kaman Dani yake.
